ctx.x: friend of mine I'll send you." He said, "All right." So I told Lucky Fowler to go up there to (?). He went there, and they sent him home. They said, "You need a banjo. We want a banjo player." So he comes dead straight to my house the next day, and I loan him my banjo -- I've got a second banjo. He went there... I showed him how to tune it up, because it's pitched high. And he went there and he made the gig. That's where he started making this money and buying his cameras.
